fields.notes: wgc_unit posted ahead of the wgc_* keys (httpd web.c:4403 / :4810); Apply restarts only the edited client: restart_wgc N, stop_wgc N when turned off (stock restart_wgc with no unit restarted all five, rc/services.c:23768-23781, B-WGC-1), start_vpnrouting0 for enable / killswitch; priv + psk type=password with reveal; addr / dns take the nvram sizes (B-WGC-2); DNS servers must be addresses (rc routes them, rc/wireguard.c:847, B-WGC-3); a disabled client is still validated (B-WGC-4); wgc_aips byte cap 996 (not JFFS-whitelisted, B-WGC-5)
fields.restoreButton: note: the stock Default button is the Reset row (stop_wgc N;clearwgclient N after a confirm, rc/services.c:23768, :22350)
fields.vpndirector_rulelist: note: read-only table of the rules naming WGCn or WAN, with a link to Reaper_VPNDirector.asp (agent C's key, not posted here)
fields.wgc.log: not carried: nvram_dump("wgc.log") runs wg show wgcN on every page load (httpd web.c:2745) and is live state; Reaper_VPNStatus.asp (agent C) is the status page
